title: Bashar - Permission Slips
author: 巴夏听闻录
opening_summary: Bashar discusses permission slips as the core concept underlying all spiritual tools, rituals, and techniques. He explains that people seek various modalities—crystals, books, meditations, channeling—asking which works best. The teaching clarifies that each person attracts the tool matching their frequency at that moment. However, the real power originates within; these external objects and practices serve only as permission slips you give yourself to authentically express who you truly are. Belief systems often create the illusion of obstacles preventing self-expression, yet experience itself is the only reality. All techniques are ultimately symbols enabling you to grant yourself permission to reveal your genuine abilities and become more fully yourself.

quotes.quote: What they really simply are are permission slips that you give to yourself to be who you are.
quotes.context: Core teaching on tools and rituals

quotes.quote: Like vibration to like vibration. You attracted it with your frequency.
Experience is the reality, not the reality you think experiencing.
You are giving yourself permission through the symbol to be more of who you are.
quotes.context: Actual source of power in practices

quotes.quote: The power does not exist in those objects, in those rituals.
You attract what reflects the belief system within you.

notes: Re-upload channel (巴夏听闻录, a Chinese-language Bashar fan channel), not official. Classic 'Permission Slips' monologue excerpt.
